title: Fix Shape To Energy Transformation
description: Fuse all shape solids, explode into external surfaces, classify each surface (roof, baseplate, slabs, external walls, windows, hull).
summary: Multi-solid energy hull volume now comes from brepjs boolean fuse of shape solids via `fuseSourceSolidIds` metadata on `from_geometry-hull`, not vertex AABB. `solidForSolidRecord` builds fused brep; AABB fallback skipped for `from_geometry-*`. Property derivation syncs solids before `solidVolume`. Tests cover separated-box hull volume ≈ 2 m³.
